about: How the payload estimate weighs an aircraft from its steady hover, and how flights are grouped into payload bands by it (spec: Vehicle fingerprinting, 'Payload estimation without a scale'; Performance trends, 'Like with like'). Starting values, not yet calibrated against the fleet's logs.
sources: libraries/AP_Motors/AP_Motors_Thrust_Linearization.cpp at Copter-4.7.0: thrust_to_actuator gives an output between MOT_SPIN_MIN and MOT_SPIN_MAX whose thrust is (1 - e) x + e x^2 of full thrust at MOT_BAT_VOLT_MAX, with x the output times the battery voltage scale; MOT_THST_EXPO is constrained to -1..1.
libraries/AP_Motors/AP_MotorsMulticopter.cpp at Copter-4.7.0: MOT_PWM_MIN and MOT_PWM_MAX of 0 fall back to the throttle channel's RC3_MIN and RC3_MAX.
ICAO Doc 7488, Manual of the ICAO Standard Atmosphere: sea-level density 1.225 kg/m3; specific gas constant of dry air 287.05 J/(kg K).

Cheeseman and Bennett, The effect of the ground on a helicopter rotor in forward flight, ARC R&M 3021 (1955): in hover, thrust rises by 1/(1 - (R/4z)^2) near the ground, under 0.3% at 3 m for a 30-inch rotor.
min_hover_s and saturated: app starting values. A motor within 1% of either end of its range no longer shows what it was asked for.

band_step, lightest_within and max_takeoff_kg: app starting values. A 10% step is about three times the estimate's error on the simulator's light/loaded pair, so a flight seldom lands in the wrong band; ArduPilot has flown aircraft up to 500 kg, so a weight over 1000 kg is a typing error.
